name: Gnomeregan Gumdrop
summary: At Hallow's End, Gnomeregan Gumdrops reach travelers from the exiled gnomes. One sweet helps sick Jesper celebrate at the Stormwind orphanage.

sections.title: A Taste of Gnomish Ingenuity
sections.body: At Ironforge's Mystic Ward, Talvash del Kissel gives travelers Gnomeregan Gumdrops when they play along with his Hallow's End tricks. Alliance innkeepers offer treats from their own lands, but the exiled gnomes have no capital inn of their own. The radioactive disaster drove them from their underground kingdom. Still, they share their distinct sweets with the Alliance.

sections.title: A Treat for Jesper
sections.body: Sick Jesper stays at the Stormwind orphanage in Cathedral Square and cannot travel the continents to trick-or-treat. So travelers gather four regional sweets from Alliance capitals and bring them to him: Gnomeregan Gumdrop, Stormwind Nougat, Ironforge Mint, and Darnassus Marzipan.

faq.q: Where does a Gnomeregan Gumdrop come from?
faq.answer: Talvash del Kissel gives out Gnomeregan Gumdrops in Ironforge's Mystic Ward when you play one of his Hallow's End tricks.

faq.q: Why isn't this candy handed out in Gnomeregan?
faq.answer: Troggs overran and irradiated Gnomeregan, driving its surviving gnomes into exile. Many now live alongside the dwarves in Ironforge, including Talvash del Kissel.

faq.q: What is this candy used for?
faq.answer: You bring this sweet to Jesper, a sick orphan boy at the Stormwind orphanage in Cathedral Square. It is one of four festive sweets gathered for him during Hallow's End.

faq.q: What other treats are collected alongside it?
faq.answer: Jesper also asks for Stormwind Nougat, Ironforge Mint, and Darnassus Marzipan. You gather each in its respective Alliance capital.

angles.text: Though gnomes have no reclaimed city of their own, their signature sweet joins those of the great Alliance capitals during Hallow's End.
You travel among human, dwarven, and gnomish communities to gather this sweet. The seasonal celebration shows the close bonds of the Alliance.
